name: Vercel AI Gateway
description: Vercel's unified AI Gateway: a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint that routes to hundreds of third-party models across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral, xAI, DeepSeek, Moonshot AI and other upstream providers; supports OIDC tokens and provider-specific BYOK keys.

authentication.notes: Either a Vercel OIDC token issued via the AI Gateway (Authorization: Bearer <oidc>), or a per-provider BYOK key (Authorization: Bearer <openai|anthropic|...>). The active provider is selected by the model id prefix.
